mapper.select: SELECT * FROM countrylanguage ORDER BY CountryCode
SELECT * FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = #{code} AND Language = #{language}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO countrylanguage (CountryCode, Language, IsOfficial, Percentage) VALUES (#{code}, #{language}, #{official}, #{usage})
mapper.update: UPDATE countrylanguage SET Percentage = #{usage}, IsOfficial = #{official} WHERE CountryCode = #{code} AND Language = #{language}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = #{code} AND Language = #{language}
